name: Lin Sujuan

name: Sadashiv Shetty
current_role: Chairman & Executive Director, Heranba Industries Ltd (Vapi, Gujarat)
profile: Sadashiv K. Shetty co-founded Heranba Industries in 1992 with Raghuram K. Shetty; it grew into a crop-protection chemicals maker and exporter (insecticides, herbicides, fungicides) based in Vapi, listed in India in 2021. He chairs the company and holds about 18% of it.
interesting_fact: Heranba's own site describes it as founded in 1992 by 'technocrats' Sadashiv K. Shetty and Raghuram K. Shetty; Sadashiv studied at the University of Mysore.
deep_cut_fact: In April 2024 he also became non-executive chairman of Daikaffil Chemicals India, a separate listed specialty-chemicals company.
notes: Wealth is shared with co-promoter Raghuram K. Shetty (Managing Director). Low media profile; corporate office in Mumbai (Borivali). Deep-cut source is an aggregator; verify with a Daikaffil BSE filing.

name: Seema Suryavanshi
current_role: Promoter/shareholder of Dilip Buildcon Ltd (Bhopal); former executive director (2006-2010)
profile: Seema Suryavanshi is a promoter of Dilip Buildcon, the Bhopal road and infrastructure EPC contractor founded by her husband Dilip Suryavanshi, who is chairman. She was a director of the company from 2006 to 2010 and has sat on boards of group entities such as Suryavanshi Infrastructure and DBL toll-road SPVs.
interesting_fact: Dilip Buildcon grew from a small Bhopal contractor into one of India's largest road builders; she was on its board when it incorporated as a company in 2006.
notes: Low public profile. Best route is through the company (head of IR Gautam Jain is named on earnings calls) or via Dilip/Rohan Suryavanshi. Her current board status is unclear: sources conflict.

name: Chen Lingyue
profile: Listed on Hurun China 2007 (US$130m) via 'Jinjia Group', printing. Most likely Shenzhen Jinjia Group (劲嘉, SZ:002191), a cigarette-pack printer that listed in 2007, but no source was found naming a 陈零越 among its founders, directors or shareholders (chairman is Qiao Luyu).
notes: Identity unresolved; the Chinese name returns no relevant hits. Check 劲嘉 2007 IPO prospectus shareholder list before any outreach.

name: Hong Zhaoshe
current_role: Chairman, Fujian Qipai Group (柒牌集团), Jinjiang
profile: Hong Zhaoshe (洪肇设, b. 1953, Yingling town, Jinjiang, Fujian) heads Qipai, a menswear brand that began as a small Jinjiang workshop in 1979 and became one of the major 'Fujian school' men's clothing groups, known for its 'Chinese stand-collar' (中华立领) suits. He is a senior engineer and was a deputy to the 10th Fujian Provincial People's Congress.
interesting_fact: Qipai's signature 中华立领 (Chinese stand-collar) line is promoted as making men's fashion distinctly Chinese; Hong wore a black Qipai stand-collar Hanfu-style suit to a 2022 brand launch.
deep_cut_fact: He was born in rural Yingling town, Jinjiang, the youngest of seven brothers, which is also where the group's early companies were registered (e.g. 晋江英林柒牌贸易).
notes: No published personal or press email found. Route via Qipai Group corporate PR in Jinjiang. Chinese-language outreach recommended.

name: Feng Yajun
profile: Listed on Hurun China 2008 (US$100m) as founder/owner of 'Zhanda Group' (展大集团) in animal feed. No online source found for 封亚军 or a feed company called 展大集团, so neither identity nor current status could be confirmed.
notes: Unresolved; possibly a small private regional feed company. Check business registries (e.g. the national enterprise credit system) with the Chinese company name.

name: Surya Prakash Madrecha
current_role: Co-founder and former Chairman & MD, Trimax IT Infrastructure & Services (Mumbai); current role unknown
profile: Udaipur-born science graduate who moved to Bombay in 1991 and co-founded Trimax IT Infrastructure & Services (incorporated 1995), growing it from a PC assembler into a systems integrator known for e-ticketing for state bus corporations (MSRTC, BEST, Rajasthan, UP, BMTC). The company entered insolvency in 2018 and was taken over by EbixCash under a 2020 resolution plan.
interesting_fact: Trimax won Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation's 2009 tender for handheld electronic ticketing machines and depot-linked software, and later built BEST's smart card (about 1.8m sold).
deep_cut_fact: 'Trimax' stands for 'try maximum'. His first job was at Sanghvi Electronics for Rs 800 a month, and his old boss Suresh Sanghvi rented him his first Lamington Road office and handed him his first two clients, Dharamsi Morarji Chemical and Arthur Andersen.
notes: Sensitive: Trimax went through insolvency (2018-2020) and lenders filed personal-guarantee proceedings against family members. Hurun wealth figure (2017-18) is likely stale. No current published contact found.

name: Janet L Cohen
current_role: Major (10%+) Symbotic shareholder through family trusts; co-trustee of The Tilia Mill Trust
profile: Janet L. Cohen is named in Symbotic's SEC filings as the wife of Symbotic founder, chairman and CEO Richard B. Cohen, and as a 10%-plus beneficial owner of the warehouse-robotics company through trusts (The Tilia Mill Trust, RBC Millennium Trust). The Cohen family fortune also comes from C&S Wholesale Grocers.
interesting_fact: Symbotic, the Wilmington, MA warehouse-automation company founded by her husband, counts Walmart as its largest customer and listed in 2022 via a SPAC merger.
notes: Private individual whose holdings are disclosed because she files as a 10% owner; SEC filings give her address only as c/o Symbotic. Better podcast target is Rick Cohen. A Feb 2024 Form 4 shows large share sales, so current stake may differ.

name: Guilherme Marques Lago
current_role: Partner, Kaszek (venture capital); Special Advisor to Nubank (CFO 2021-July 2026)
profile: Brazilian finance executive who spent about 13 years at Credit Suisse (rising to managing director), with earlier stints at McKinsey and Advent, then joined Nubank in June 2019 and became CFO in Feb 2021, steering its 2021 NYSE IPO and growth in Mexico and Colombia. He handed the CFO role to Rob Livingston in July 2026 and became a partner at Kaszek.
interesting_fact: He was CFO through Nubank's December 2021 NYSE IPO, one of the largest Latin American listings, as the company grew from a regional fintech into one of the world's largest digital banks.
deep_cut_fact: After leaving the CFO role he joined Kaszek, the VC firm that backed Nubank in its early rounds, writing that 'few companies shape Latin American technology as deeply as Kaszek'.
notes: Active on LinkedIn (announced the Kaszek move there). Kaszek is the best current route; Nubank IR is only useful for his advisory role. Kaszek role is reported by one outlet.
